action_boundary: Executable outputs recommend proposal-design actions and conditional options only. They do not authorize external action or certify political feasibility.
decision_question: What preparatory cooperation strategy remains defensible when a proposed data contribution becomes unavailable, and which commitments must remain conditional?
description: A development case for comparing centralized, federated and project-specific cooperation strategies. An anonymous proposed data contribution is initially available as a modeling assumption. Preparatory proposal design is allowed; real partner consent, processing permissions, resources and evaluation capacity are unresolved. No pilot, country commitment or actual data contribution is asserted.
title: Proposed Japan–Thailand–Vietnam local-language AI cooperation
